items.title: Hide Tanaka interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 3, 2014
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] No. When I came in the eighties he was still around.

ctx.x: Oh, this is — he’s a good photographer too. Yes, slap bass. Milt Hinton.
To me the bass player, when you don’t have a drummer, the bass player becomes the drummer too. Did you ever get to meet Milt Hinton?
